baseline_test_failure: Untouched baseline lacks exact_quadratic_normal_form in the no-GMP-analog API inventory; default/all-target and coverage runs stop at that assertion. Supplementary default/all-feature all-target and complete coverage matrices PASS with only that classification entry added. Production sources and benchmark fixtures remain unchanged; original failure logs and the exact test-only patch are preserved.

fuzz.finding: Both revisions return a legitimate unknown for root_8(1/92)^8 - 1/92 at -512 precision. A derived maximum certificate depth of 730 bits supports the corrected -1024 harness request. The five-byte seed and degree/denominator/nonzero controls are committed in add6365. Each corrected run completed 2727 sanitizer executions over 2575 saved corpus files.
fuzz.sanitizer_limitation: AddressSanitizer retained. LeakSanitizer failed under ptrace; diagnostic logs preserved before retrying with detect_leaks=0.

saved_corpora.note: The real_elementary corrected-harness runs already replayed all 2575 frozen inputs; the other five targets subsequently replayed the full frozen corpora. All twelve final per-revision/target replay results passed with AddressSanitizer enabled and LeakSanitizer disabled only after its ptrace diagnostic.
